subject: DSS5101 final project report: due tomorrow
body:
Hi,

A reminder that the final project report for DSS5101 is due tomorrow, {weekday+1} {day+1}, at 11:59 PM on Canvas. Late submissions lose 10% per day and I cannot make exceptions after the deadline.

Please also check that your team's contribution statement is attached.

Regards,
Prof. Hart

subject: Group meeting time?
body: Hey, can we meet this week to finish the presentation slides? I am free Wednesday after 4 PM or Thursday morning. Which works for you? Please reply so I can book a room.

subject: Assignment Due: DSS5101 CA4 Report
body:
DSS5101 - Data Science in Practice

Assignment due: CA4 Report
Due: {weekday+3}, {day+3} at 11:59 PM

View Assignment https://canvas.demo.nus.edu.sg/courses/5101/assignments/4

subject: New Announcement: DSS5105 tutorial rescheduled
body:
DSS5105 - Business Analytics

The tutorial on {weekday+1} is moved to 2:00 PM in COM1-0210. Please bring your laptop.

View Announcement https://canvas.demo.nus.edu.sg/courses/5105/announcements/12

subject: Interview invitation: Data Analyst Intern, Northwind Analytics
body:
Dear student,

Thank you for applying. We would like to invite you to an online interview on {weekday+4}, {day+4} at 2:30 PM (Singapore time) via Zoom. Please confirm your availability by replying to this email by {weekday+2}.

Best regards,
Sofia Tan, Northwind Analytics

subject: Appointment reminder: tomorrow 10:30 AM
body: This is a reminder of your appointment at the University Health Centre, Level 2, on {weekday+1}, {day+1} at 10:30 AM. Please bring your student card. To cancel or change, call us at least 24 hours before.

subject: Undergraduate scholarship: application closes {day+9}
body:
Dear students,

Applications for the Faculty Merit Scholarship close on {day+9} at 5:00 PM. Submit your form and transcript through the student portal. Late applications will not be considered.

subject: Your premium payment is due in 6 days
body: Your student health insurance premium of SGD 84.00 is due on {day+6}. Unpaid premiums may lead to suspension of your coverage. Pay online using your policy number.

subject: ACTION REQUIRED: your password expires today, verify now
body:
Your university password will expire TODAY. Click the link below and enter your username and password to keep your account active, or it will be deleted within 24 hours.

http://nus-account-verify.example-login.com/reset

subject: Data Science Seminar: Thursday 3 PM, LT19
body: You are invited to the Data Science Seminar "Forecasting with limited data" on {weekday+2}, {day+2} at 3:00 PM in LT19. Light refreshments will be served. No registration needed.

subject: Overdue notice: 1 item
body: The item "Introduction to Statistical Learning" was due 3 days ago. A fine of SGD 0.50 per day applies until it is returned or renewed. You can renew it online.

subject: Faculty of Science: exam timetable released
body: The final examination timetable for this semester is now available on the student portal. Please check your papers carefully. The exam period starts on {day+35}.

subject: 50% off everything this weekend only!
body:
Huge weekend sale! Get 50% off laptops, headphones and more. Use code NUS50 at checkout.

To stop receiving these emails, click unsubscribe. Manage your preferences or view this email in your browser.

subject: This month at the Photography Club
body: Hi everyone! Our monthly photowalk is on {day+12}. Meet at the Central Library at 9 AM. All skill levels welcome. Unsubscribe any time.

subject: Laundry room maintenance on {weekday+5}
body: The Block B laundry room will be closed on {weekday+5}, {day+5}, from 9 AM to 1 PM for maintenance. Please use the Block A laundry room during this time.

subject: Lunch after the lecture?
body: A few of us are getting lunch at the canteen after Friday's lecture. Want to join? No rush, let me know whenever.

subject: Exciting opportunities in your area
body: Hello, we have many job openings that might interest you. Register on our website to see all roles. This is a mass mailing to our subscribers.

subject: DSS5105 quiz 2 grades released
body: Hi all, quiz 2 grades are now on Canvas. The class average was 74%. If you would like to discuss your paper, my consultation hours are Tuesdays 3 to 5 PM in COM1-0310.

subject: Scheduled maintenance this weekend
body: The student portal will be unavailable on {weekday+4} from 11 PM to {weekday+5} 3 AM for scheduled maintenance. No action is needed.

subject: Your monthly statement is ready
body: Your statement for last month is now available in online banking. This is an automated message, please do not reply.

subject: Can you review my CV before Friday?
body: Hi! I am applying for the Northwind internship and the deadline is {weekday+3}. Could you have a quick look at my CV and tell me what to improve? Thank you so much!

subject: Welfare pack collection
body: Collect your free welfare pack at the Student Union office between {day+6} and {day+8}, 10 AM to 4 PM. Bring your student card.
